members.strategy: 已晋级T8-svepanel16原样三轮复测，建立本轮KML25.1/GCC12基线；后续以同版本新run和候选同分配交错比较。

Large-path 8-row x 16-column SVE update reuses each L coefficient across two 8-column accumulators. Preserve increasing-k zero-based FMA followed by one C subtraction, KB256/CT64, packing, scheduling, and tails. Compare against T8 to test coefficient reuse.

From T8, add only three empty compiler constraints on a15 after within-block q=3,7,11 to consume its dependent FMA chain earlier; preserve all arithmetic, history, layout, allocation and dispatch. Test actual scheduling effect against T8; no spill-repair assumption.
